`docs/reference/tools/30-php-differences.md` is one concept page with three sections: *The short list* (with *What Novis can do that PHP cannot* under it), *Porting a program* (new, carrying the cart program `tests/conformance/lang/the-php-differences-two-spellings-side-by-side-program-runs-as-written.nvst` pins) and *The tools you do not install*. The primer no longer lifts anything from the chapter: `PRIMER_FIRST` in `crates/nvs-cli/src/agent.rs` is three chapters, and `rule:tooling/a-primer-claim-is-executed` no longer fixes a refusal table.
